item.title: Meru: oil isn't the whole story behind the Treasury yield spike, the US deficit and Big Tech debt are crowding it too
item.dc:creator: 메르
item.description: Rising oil prices explain only part of the Treasury yield spike, Korean investment blogger Meru argues, the bigger driver is a structural mismatch between how much debt Washington needs to sell and how much the market wants to buy. The 10-year yield broke above 4.7% intraday, and most coverage blames it on crude, since the Strait of Hormuz is blocked again and Houthi attacks threaten the Red Sea.…
